scenarios.title: Clean invoice, fully received
scenarios.story: Acme bills PO-4404 exactly as ordered. Everything was received last week.

scenarios.title: Valid invoice, unsafe payment
scenarios.story: A perfect 3-way match on PO-4410, but emailed from acme-supp1y.com (a lookalike), with a new bank account, urgent wording and a line aimed at automated systems.

scenarios.title: Partial delivery
scenarios.story: Northwind bills all 100 controller boards on PO-4420, but receiving has logged only 60. Post GRN-883 (+40) during the demo and the held amount releases by itself.

scenarios.title: Split-PO overrun
scenarios.story: Globex already billed 80 of 100 belt sections on PO-4430 across two invoices. Receiving accepted an over-shipment (110). This third invoice bills 30 more, taking the PO past its total.

scenarios.title: Phone photo, PO implied, VAT included
scenarios.story: A Dutch supplier's invoice photographed on a desk: perspective, shadow, a stain over the total. Prices include 21% VAT, amounts use a decimal comma, and no PO is printed. Rijnmond has three open POs.

scenarios.title: Indian GST invoice (English + Hindi)
scenarios.story: A bilingual GST tax invoice from a Pune supplier: GSTIN, HSN codes, CGST + SGST, rupee amounts in lakh grouping.

scenarios.title: Scanned, no invoice number
scenarios.story: A scanned typewriter-style invoice from Initech with no invoice number printed.

scenarios.title: Close but not exact
scenarios.story: Initech's prices are about 1.2% above the PO and there is a $40 freight line. Both are inside tolerance.

scenarios.title: Duplicate, reformatted
scenarios.story: Initech resubmits INV-0042 (already paid) as invoice '42' on a different template.

scenarios.title: Statement of account
scenarios.story: Northwind sends a monthly statement, not an invoice.

scenarios.title: Tampered PDF
scenarios.story: The visible IBAN (pixels) is not the IBAN in the PDF's hidden text layer. Both readers can be fooled; the render check is not.

series.title: Acme switches to a new template
series.story: Same vendor, same PO, new invoice design. The learned layout no longer fits, so Clearline does a full read.

# Clearline AP policy

## Tolerances

- `price_pct`: 0.02
- `price_abs`: 5.0
- `freight_abs`: 50.0
- `po_overrun_pct`: 0.01
- `reconcile_abs`: 0.02
- `tax_abs`: 0.05
- `jev_bank_change`: 0.5
- `jev_pressure_level`: 2
- `jev_instructs`: 0.5
- `lookalike_max`: 3
- `bank_change_days`: 30
- `apr_limit`: 25000
- `pair_p_min`: 0.95

### Vendor-specific

- V-1001: `freight_abs` = 0.0

## Checks

- **DOC-01** Document is an invoice
- **DOC-02** Visible text matches the text layer (locked)
- **EXT-01** Critical fields present
- **EXT-02** No decision field is uncertain
- **EXT-03** Lines, tax and freight add up to the total
- **VEN-01** Vendor identified without ambiguity
- **VEN-02** Vendor is approved
- **PO-01** Purchase order identified
- **PO-02** PO is open, same vendor, same currency
- **PO-03** Cumulative billing within the PO total
- **MAT-00** Every goods line matches a PO line
- **MAT-01** Prices match the PO
- **MAT-02** Billed quantity received
- **MAT-03** Freight within allowance
- **DUP-01** Not a duplicate (locked)
- **DUP-02** No near-duplicate
- **PAY-01** Bank details match the verified account (locked)
- **PAY-02** Sent from the vendor's own domain (locked)
- **PAY-03** No bank-change request or pressure (locked)
- **PAY-04** Established payee, no recent bank change (locked)
- **SEC-01** Document does not address automated systems (locked)
- **TAX-01** Tax arithmetic and tax ID valid
- **NPO-01** Non-PO amount within the usual range
- **APR-01** Within AP approval limit
